reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: verifyAccessToken has an active non-test caller at src/app/oauth/userinfo/route.ts:24. Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json contains no trust_assumptions; the attack entry point is an unauthenticated external HTTP request (untrusted). Gate 3: src/app/oauth/ (userinfo) is explicitly in scope. The hardcoded fallback JWT_SECRET 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' is confirmed at oauth.ts:11. An attacker can trigger this via the GET /oauth/userinfo endpoint by crafting an HS256 JWT signed with the publicly visible default secret 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' and sending it as a Bearer token, causing verifyAccessToken to return a non-null payload and the endpoint to return attacker-impersonated member profile data on any deployment where JWT_SECRET is not set.
